title: Yocoboué Dida language and alphabet
text: Yocoboué Dida is a member of the Eastern Kru branch of the Niger-Congo language family. It is spoken in southern Ivory Coast, mainly in and around the town of Guitry in the Gôh-Djiboua district, and in the Tagbo Lagoon in the neighbouring Lagunes district.
